verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says every pull request gets its own preview, and that it offers unlimited environments and instant previews, so per-PR previews are a first-party capability. The evidence is only short homepage claims. It does not show that previews include the full stack (databases and multiple services) or that they are torn down automatically on merge or close. Missing for 10: documented full-stack scope of PR environments (databases/services cloned), documented ephemeral lifecycle/auto-teardown, in-depth docs beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request

citations.quote: Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.
Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously.
Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
